experiments.mechanism: Stable at-least-two-table log inclusion and regularized correction (#68); finite estimator bias and maintained input-domain validation (#67).

conditions.execution: portable selected scalar helper and transform bodies, no Torch/CUDA/model dependencies
conditions.seed: fixed literal deterministic fixture, no RNG
conditions.oracle: Exhaustive independent bit/table outcomes; positive FP64/extended-precision binomial masses; 54 independently generated 160-digit Decimal reference literals; finite estimator expectations.
conditions.estimator_model: 64 exhaustive outcomes for two synthetic independent candidate table-hit processes; conditional on nonempty set, not shared geometric LSH hyperplanes
conditions.invalid_domains: Invalid scalar domains throw before any borrowed scores are mutated; accepted cosine overshoot limited to 8 FP32 epsilons; no index upper-bound inference.

experiments.note: Support: supplied logits only, not end-to-end unbiased self-normalized attention. Issue #67 repairs scalar-domain validation; Issue #68 repairs tiny-inclusion arithmetic and deliberately replaces the old cancellation expectation. Explicit+1e-4 smoothing remains. Exceptions require safe transport at OpenMP caller boundaries.
